---
title: "Resources"
order: 11
---

External links for this lesson. All checked to load from a plain request as of the date this
page was written. (Note: eCFR's and fda.gov's own rendered sites block automated/proxied traffic
with a bot check in this repo's build environment, even though a human browser reaches them fine;
the regulation text quoted in this lesson comes from eCFR's public Versioner API instead, and the
links below use verified-loading mirrors of the same official text.)

- **[Cornell LII: 21 CFR 606.100, current text](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/606.100)**
  — the standard operating procedures requirement this lesson applies to BECS directly. Use this
  to check the current text, since regulations get amended and the copy in this repo's `sources/`
  folder is a dated snapshot.

- **[Cornell LII: 21 CFR 11.10, current text](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/11.10)** —
  the "controls for closed systems" section, including the systems-validation clause this lesson
  quotes. This module names Part 11 only briefly; Track 3 (`csv-and-becs`) covers the full
  electronic-records framework this section sits inside.

- **[Cornell LII: 21 CFR 606.171, current text](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/606.171)**
  — the biological product deviation reporting section this lesson applies to a software defect,
  already covered in full in the `risk-and-controls-vocabulary` foundation lesson.

- **[GovInfo: Code of Federal Regulations](https://www.govinfo.gov/app/collection/cfr)** — the
  U.S. Government Publishing Office's official, legally authoritative annual CFR archive. Use this
  for the official, dated, legally citable version of a specific year's text — for example, to
  confirm exactly what a section said on the date of a past inspection or a vendor change.
